purpose: S4 shadow integration acceptance. Live v1.5 is canonical; v2 uses scripted semantic facts so provider quality is not claimed.

parallel_cases.project_brief: A SaaS hosts many customer organizations in shared infrastructure.
parallel_cases.request: Add an authenticated endpoint that lets an organization download its audit log while preventing members of any other organization from reading those entries.

parallel_cases.project_brief: A public service backend can reach both internet and private infrastructure.
parallel_cases.request: Create a public preview API where the caller supplies a remote resource location and the backend HTTP client retrieves that location before returning metadata.

parallel_cases.project_brief: A general software product has no documented clinical policy, jurisdiction, regulatory classification or qualified clinical authority.
parallel_cases.request: Add logic that decides whether a patient should receive urgent clinical treatment from reported symptoms and measurements. No approved clinical decision policy has been supplied.

parallel_cases.project_brief: A production relational database serves live traffic continuously.
parallel_cases.request: Transform roughly 80 million existing rows to populate a new derived field while normal writes continue; design execution to bound database load, locking and rollout risk.

parallel_cases.project_brief: A web application delegates employee authentication to an outside corporate identity provider.
parallel_cases.request: Implement an OIDC authorization-code redirect and callback with the external identity provider, then establish the local session after validating the returned authorization response.

parallel_cases.project_brief: Repository documentation includes developer examples; no delivery change is requested.
parallel_cases.request: Add a README sentence showing the existing docker run command. Do not change images, dependencies, CI, build or release configuration.
